question_variations: How can I move around the chart?
What are the ways to navigate the chart?
intent_routes.answer: You can move the chart in any direction by either dragging the screen or moving the cursor to the edge of the chart panel using the arrow keys.

intent_routes.question: What are the different chart orientation options?
question_variations: How can I change chart orientation?
What chart rotation options are available?
intent_routes.answer: The available chart orientations are: North up (displays chart with north upward), Heading up (displays chart with vessel's heading upward), Course up (orients based on navigation status), and Look ahead (maximizes view ahead of vessel).

intent_routes.question: How do I view information about items on the chart?
question_variations: How can I see details about chart objects?
What's the way to get information about chart items?
intent_routes.answer: Select a chart item (waypoint, route, or target) to view basic information in a pop-up. Select the pop-up to display all available information. You can also activate the detailed information dialog from the menu. Note: Pop-up information must be enabled in chart settings.

intent_routes.question: What happens when GPS position is lost?
question_variations: How does the vessel symbol change without GPS?
What indicates loss of GPS position?
intent_routes.answer: When there is no valid GPS position available, the vessel symbol will include a question mark. Without heading information, the vessel icon will orient itself using COG (Course over Ground).

intent_routes.question: How do I return to vessel position on the chart?
question_variations: How can I center the chart on my boat?
How do I get back to my vessel location?
intent_routes.answer: Use the return to vessel option to center the chart back on your vessel position

intent_routes.question: How do I control the chart view angle?
question_variations: How can I rotate the chart view?
How do I change chart perspective?
intent_routes.answer: Select the rotate icon, then pan horizontally to change view direction and vertically to change tilt angle. Note that when centered on vessel, only tilt can be adjusted.

intent_routes.question: How do I color code my tracks?
question_variations: Can I change track colors based on data?
How do I set track coloring?
intent_routes.answer: Tracks can be colored based on source data by selecting a data type and setting high/low limits. Colors range from green (high) to yellow (middle) to red (low), with gradient colors in between.

intent_routes.question: What is the Heat Map overlay?
question_variations: How does the temperature overlay work?
What does the Heat Map show?
intent_routes.answer: The Heat Map overlay shows water temperature history using color coding on the chart. It requires a water temperature source and automatically adjusts colors based on recorded min/max temperatures.

intent_routes.question: How do I adjust Heat Map transparency?
question_variations: Can I change Heat Map overlay opacity?
How do I make the Heat Map more visible?
intent_routes.answer: Select the transparency option in the Heat Map overlay menu. Lower transparency settings will make the overlay more prominent, nearly hiding panel details.

intent_routes.question: How do I activate the cursor on the panel?
question_variations: Where is the cursor on my panel?
How do I show the cursor?
How to enable cursor display?
intent_routes.answer: By default, the cursor is not shown. When activated, the cursor position window will be displayed. Note that when cursor is active, the panel will not pan or rotate to follow the vessel.

intent_routes.question: What is the cursor assist function?
question_variations: How does cursor assist work?
Can I get help with cursor placement?
How to use precision cursor placement?
intent_routes.answer: Cursor assist allows for fine tuning and precision placement without covering details with your finger. Press and hold your finger on the screen to switch cursor to a selection circle above your finger. Drag the circle to desired position while keeping finger on screen. Cursor reverts to normal when finger is removed.

intent_routes.question: How do I measure distance on the chart?
question_variations: Can I measure between two points?
How to check distance between positions?
What's the distance measuring process?
intent_routes.answer: Position cursor on desired point, select measure function from menu. Measuring icons appear with line from vessel to cursor, showing distance in cursor window. Points can be repositioned by dragging icons. Bearing is measured from grey icon to blue icon.

intent_routes.question: How do I create a new route on the chart panel?
question_variations: What are the steps to make a route?
How to plot a route?
Can I create waypoint routes?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Activate cursor on chart panel 2. Select new route option from menu 3. Position first waypoint 4. Continue positioning remaining route points 5. Save route by selecting save option in menu

intent_routes.question: What objects can I search for on chart panels?
question_variations: What items can I find on charts?
How to search for things on chart panel?
What can I locate on my chart?
intent_routes.answer: You can search for: Waypoints, Chart Items, Overlay, Routes, Coordinates, Tracks, Vessels, and Fuel stations (requires SiriusXM subscription). AIS receiver required for vessel searches.

intent_routes.question: How do 3D charts work?
question_variations: What is 3D chart mode?
Can I view charts in 3D?
How to use 3D chart view?
intent_routes.answer: 3D option provides three-dimensional graphical view of land and sea contours. All chart types work in 3D mode, but area needs 3D cartography or chart appears flat. When 3D selected, rotate and pan icons appear on panel.

intent_routes.question: How do C-MAP tides and currents work?
question_variations: How can I see tides and currents on C-MAP?
What do the tide and current icons mean on C-MAP?
intent_routes.answer: C-MAP displays tides and currents as square icons marked with T (Tides) or C (Current). Dynamic current data appears when zoomed within 1-nautical mile, showing animated icons colored by speed: black (>6 knots), red (2-6 knots), yellow (1-2 knots), green (≤1 knot), white (0 knots).

intent_routes.question: What is photo overlay in C-MAP charts?
question_variations: How does photo overlay work?
Can I see satellite images on C-MAP?
intent_routes.answer: Photo overlay displays satellite photo images as an overlay on the chart in either 2D or 3D modes. Options include No Photo overlay, Photo overlay land only, or Full Photo overlay. Availability is limited to certain regions and cartography versions.

intent_routes.question: What chart detail levels are available?
question_variations: How do I change chart detail settings?
What are the different chart detail options?
intent_routes.answer: Three chart detail levels are available: Full (all available information), Medium (minimum information for navigation), and Low (basic level information required for all geographic areas, not sufficient for safe navigation).

intent_routes.question: How does depth palette work?
question_variations: What is the navigation depth palette?
How are depths colored on the chart?
intent_routes.answer: The Navigation depth palette colors depth areas based on depth range values. The system uses darker shades of blue for shallower water and whiter colors for deeper water, selecting exact colors based on specific depth ranges.

intent_routes.question: What happens to heat map data when the unit is turned off?
question_variations: Is heat map data saved when powered down?
Does the system retain heat map information?
intent_routes.answer: Heat map data is automatically deleted when the unit is turned off.

intent_routes.question: How does depth shading work on the chart display?
question_variations: What are the depth shading colors?
How are water depths shown on the display?
How does the chart show different water depths?
intent_routes.answer: Depth shading colors areas based on depth values, with darker shades of blue in deeper water and whiter shades in shallower water. The system interpolates colors based on the depth within the range.

intent_routes.question: What is safety shading on the chart?
question_variations: How does safety depth shading work?
What does the safety depth limit do?
How are safety depths displayed?
intent_routes.answer: Safety shading colors depth areas based on a user-specified safety depth limit. Areas beyond this limit are drawn without blue shading to distinguish between safe and potentially unsafe water depths.

intent_routes.question: How do I adjust custom depth shading?
question_variations: Can I customize depth colors?
How to change depth shading settings?
Where are the depth shading controls?
intent_routes.answer: You can customize depth shading by adjusting the depth threshold, color, and opacity (transparency) for Depth 1 and Depth 2 settings. The system allows setting different depth points from 10m to 100m with corresponding opacity percentages.

intent_routes.question: What is the Genesis Layer?
question_variations: How does Genesis Layer work?
What does Genesis Layer show?
Can I see Genesis data on my chart?
intent_routes.answer: The Genesis Layer displays high-resolution contours contributed by Genesis users that have passed quality checks. This feature can be toggled on/off and is only available if the C-MAP chart contains Genesis Layer data.

intent_routes.question: How does photo overlay work on Navionics charts?
question_variations: Can I see satellite photos on my chart?
How do I adjust photo transparency?
What is photo overlay on Navionics?
intent_routes.answer: Photo overlay displays satellite photo images as an overlay on the chart in both 2D and 3D modes. The transparency can be adjusted from minimum to maximum, where minimum transparency nearly hides chart details behind the photo. This feature is limited to certain regions and cartography versions.

intent_routes.question: How do I adjust chart transparency?
question_variations: How can I change the chart overlay transparency?
How do I make the chart more visible through the overlay?
intent_routes.answer: Chart transparency can be adjusted from minimum to maximum. At minimum transparency, chart details are almost hidden by the photo overlay. Increase transparency to make chart details more visible through the overlay.

intent_routes.question: What is SonarChart Live?
question_variations: How does SonarChart Live work?
What does the SonarChart Live feature do?
intent_routes.answer: SonarChart Live is a real-time feature that creates an overlay of depth contours based on your own live sonar soundings. The overlay is drawn on top of other chart data and can be adjusted for transparency.

intent_routes.question: How do I set up Fishing Range highlighting?
question_variations: How can I highlight specific fishing depths?
What is the Fishing Range feature?
intent_routes.answer: Select a range of depths which Navionics will fill with white color to highlight specific depths for fishing. For example, you can set a Depth Highlight Range of 6m - 12m. The accuracy depends on the underlying chart contour line intervals.

intent_routes.question: What is the Shallow Water Highlight feature?
question_variations: How does shallow water highlighting work?
How do I mark shallow areas on the chart?
intent_routes.answer: Shallow Water Highlight marks areas of shallow water between 0 and your selected depth (up to 10 meters/30 feet). This helps identify potentially dangerous shallow areas.

intent_routes.question: How do safety depths work on Navionics charts?
question_variations: What do the blue shades mean on Navionics charts?
How are different depths shown on the chart?
intent_routes.answer: Navionics charts use different shades of blue to distinguish between shallow and deep water. When you set a safety depth limit, areas deeper than that limit are drawn without blue shading. The built-in database has depth data to 20m, after which it appears white.

intent_routes.question: How do current speed indicators work on the chart?
question_variations: What do the current arrows mean?
How are currents displayed?
What do red and blue current symbols mean?
intent_routes.answer: Current speed is shown by arrows where length indicates rate and rotation shows direction. Flow rate appears inside the arrow. Red symbols indicate increasing speed, blue symbols indicate decreasing speed.

intent_routes.question: How are tide heights displayed?
question_variations: What do the tide gauges show?
How can I read tide information?
What do red and blue tide arrows mean?
intent_routes.answer: Tide heights are shown on an 8-label gauge scaled to daily max/min values. Red arrows indicate rising tides, blue arrows indicate falling tides. Values display in user-selected units.

intent_routes.question: What is the Rock Filter Level setting?
question_variations: How do I hide underwater rocks?
What does rock filter do?
How can I declutter rock markings?
intent_routes.answer: Rock Filter Level hides rock identification markers on the chart below a specified depth, helping declutter areas with many rocks deeper than your vessel's draught.

intent_routes.question: What are extension lines?
question_variations: How do vessel extension lines work?
What do the heading and course lines show?
How are AIS target extensions displayed?
intent_routes.answer: Extension lines show vessel heading and course over ground (COG). Heading appears in blue when compass source is available, otherwise COG shows in blue. Length can be fixed distance or time-based movement. Lines available for your vessel and AIS targets.

intent_routes.question: What is Easy View mode?
question_variations: How do I make chart text bigger?
What does Easy View setting do?
How can I magnify chart details?
intent_routes.answer: Easy View is a magnification feature that increases the size of chart items and text. Note that there is no visible indication on the chart when this feature is active.

intent_routes.question: How do I show waypoints on the chart?
question_variations: Can I display waypoints on my chart?
How to make waypoints visible on chart panel?
Why aren't my waypoints showing on the chart?
intent_routes.answer: To display waypoints, enable the Waypoints option in the chart settings dialog. You can toggle waypoints on/off from the chart panel settings.
references: Page 38, Waypoints, Routes, and Tracks section

intent_routes.question: What is SonarChart Live tide correction?
question_variations: How does tide correction work in SonarChart?
Does SonarChart adjust for tides?
intent_routes.answer: SonarChart Live tide correction uses information from nearby tide stations to automatically adjust depth values as sonar is recorded. This feature only works when tide stations are available in the area.
references: Page 38, SonarChart Live tide correction section

intent_routes.question: How do I sync 2D and 3D charts?
question_variations: Can I link 2D and 3D chart views?
How to coordinate 2D/3D chart positions?
intent_routes.answer: Enable the Synchronize 2D/3D chart option to link the position shown on both charts when viewing 2D and 3D charts side by side.

intent_routes.question: Where do I enter PredictWind credentials?
question_variations: How to setup PredictWind settings?
Where are the PredictWind weather settings?
intent_routes.answer: Enter PredictWind credentials in the PredictWind Settings menu. These credentials are used for downloading weather files and routes from the PredictWind website.

intent_routes.question: How do I display tracks on the chart?
question_variations: Why can't I see tracks on my chart?
What settings enable track display?
intent_routes.answer: To display tracks, you must enable both the Display option in the Tracks dialog AND the tracks option in the chart settings dialog.
references: Page 38, Waypoints, Routes, and Tracks section

intent_routes.question: What are laylines?
question_variations: Can you explain laylines?
What do laylines show on the chart?
intent_routes.answer: Laylines are lines displayed on the chart that indicate the target course for the boat, showing paths from both the boat position and mark/waypoint to help navigate efficiently.

intent_routes.question: How do I enable boat laylines?
question_variations: Where do I turn on boat laylines?
How can I see laylines from my boat?
intent_routes.answer: Select 'Boat' option in the Laylines menu to display laylines from your boat position. You can also enable 'Always show boat laylines' for permanent display.

intent_routes.question: What is tidal flow correction for laylines?
question_variations: How does tidal correction work with laylines?
Do laylines account for tides?
intent_routes.answer: Tidal flow correction applies the system's calculated tidal vector to the laylines to automatically adjust them for tidal flow, providing more accurate navigation guidance.

intent_routes.question: How do I set layline length?
question_variations: Can I change how long laylines appear?
What's the maximum layline length?
intent_routes.answer: You can set the length of laylines in the Laylines menu. The default setting is 10 nm. Note that this option is only available when Boat option is not selected.

intent_routes.question: What are layline targets?
question_variations: How do layline targets work?
What are TWS targets in laylines?
intent_routes.answer: Layline targets define the target angles and speeds for different True Wind Speeds (TWS). These can be sourced from H5000 CPU Polar table, live measurements, manual entries for upwind/downwind angles, or from the targets table.

intent_routes.question: How do I edit the laylines targets table?
question_variations: Where can I modify layline target values?
How do I update TWA and BS values?
intent_routes.answer: Access the targets table through Laylines > Targets > Edit Targets Table. Here you can specify Upwind True Wind Angle (TWA), Upwind Boat Speed (BS), Downwind TWA, and Downwind BS values for different true wind speeds.

intent_routes.question: What are layline limits?
question_variations: How do layline limits work?
What do the dotted lines show in laylines?
intent_routes.answer: Layline limits show historic wind shift data with dotted lines on either side of the layline, indicating how far the wind has shifted over a selected time period. This helps identify wind shift phases and determine optimal tacking times.

intent_routes.question: How do I display tracks on the chart panel?
question_variations: Why can't I see tracks on my chart?
What settings do I need to show tracks?
How to enable track display?
intent_routes.answer: To display tracks, you must enable both the Display option in the Tracks dialog AND the tracks option in the chart settings dialog.

intent_routes.question: Where do I find advanced waypoint settings?
question_variations: How do I edit waypoint settings?
Where are the waypoint controls?
How to access waypoint dialog?
intent_routes.answer: Access advanced waypoint settings through the Waypoints, Routes, and Tracks dialogs menu. Select the Waypoints tab to view and edit waypoint details.

intent_routes.question: What information is shown for each waypoint?
question_variations: What details can I see about waypoints?
What waypoint data is displayed?
How do I view waypoint information?
intent_routes.answer: Waypoint information includes Icon, Name, Distance, Position (latitude/longitude), and Time/Date of creation.

intent_routes.question: Where do I find the XTE limit setting?
question_variations: How do I set XTE limit?
What page shows XTE limit?
Where is the XTE limit control?
intent_routes.answer: The XTE limit setting can be found on page 49 of the manual.

intent_routes.question: How do I create a new waypoint?
question_variations: How can I add a waypoint?
What's the process to make a waypoint?
How do I mark a position?
intent_routes.answer: You can save a waypoint in three ways: Press the rotary knob, press the Mark key, or select the new waypoint option in the menu. Waypoints can be placed at the cursor position if active or at the vessel's position if cursor is not active.

intent_routes.question: What is a waypoint?
question_variations: Can you explain what waypoints are?
What does a waypoint do?
Define waypoint
intent_routes.answer: A waypoint is a user-generated mark positioned on the chart, echosounder image, or radar image. It has exact latitude and longitude coordinates, and waypoints on the echosounder also include depth values. Waypoints are used to mark positions you want to return to later and can be combined to create routes.

intent_routes.question: How do I move a waypoint?
question_variations: Can I relocate a waypoint?
What's the process to change waypoint location?
How to reposition a waypoint?
intent_routes.answer: To move a waypoint, first select it and choose the move waypoint menu option. Then select the new location on the image. Save the waypoint at the new position by selecting the finish moving menu option.

intent_routes.question: How do I delete waypoints?
question_variations: Can I remove waypoints?
What's the process to erase waypoints?
How to get rid of waypoints?
intent_routes.answer: You can delete waypoints in several ways: Select delete from the menu when the waypoint is activated on the panel, delete it through the routes dialog and edit waypoint dialog, or delete all waypoints/waypoints by symbols using the waypoints dialog. MOB waypoints can be deleted the same way.

intent_routes.question: How do I create a new route?
question_variations: What's the process to make a route?
How can I plot a new route?
Steps to create a route?
intent_routes.answer: To create a new route: 1. Activate the cursor on the chart panel 2. Select the new route option from the menu 3. Position the first waypoint 4. Continue positioning new routepoints until route is completed 5. Save the route by selecting the save option in the menu.
references: Page 40, Creating a New Route section

intent_routes.question: How do I create a race route?
question_variations: What are the steps to make a race route?
How can I set up a racing route?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Enable the race route feature by selecting Race in Advanced Settings Features. 2. Create a new route or select existing route. 3. Open Edit Route dialog. 4. Select Race mode option and add rounding indicators. Set finish line waypoint.
references: Page 40, Creating a Race Route section

intent_routes.question: How do I set rounding indicators for a race route?
question_variations: What are the options for rounding indicators?
How do I specify route rounding settings?
intent_routes.answer: Edit the route using Edit Route dialog. Select from dropdown options: Auto (automatic determination), Port (round to port), Stbd (round to starboard), or Finish (waypoint is finish line). Save settings after selection.

intent_routes.question: How do I edit a route on the chart panel?
question_variations: What steps do I follow to modify an existing route?
How can I change a route on the chart?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Select route to activate it. 2. Select route edit option in menu. 3. Position new routepoint on chart panel. 4. Drag routepoint to new position if needed. 5. Save route using save option in menu.
references: Page 40, Edit a Route from the Chart Panel section

intent_routes.question: How do I create a route using existing waypoints?
question_variations: Can I make a route from waypoints I already have?
How do I combine existing waypoints into a route?
intent_routes.answer: Access the Routes dialog through the Waypoints tool on Home page, then select Routes tab. Use bulk insert option to enter list of waypoints separated by commas (e.g., 21,22,23,24) to create new route or add multiple waypoints to existing route.
references: Creating Routes Using Existing Waypoints section

intent_routes.question: What happens to the route display during navigation?
question_variations: How does the route appear while racing?
What colors show route progress?
intent_routes.answer: Unnavigated portions of the route are highlighted orange. Navigated portions turn black. Only the next rounding indicator is shown on the display during active navigation.

intent_routes.question: How do I create a new route?
question_variations: What are the steps to make a new route?
How can I start a new route?
What's the process for creating a route?
intent_routes.answer: Select Routes on the Tool panel, then select New button and choose Create using route list. Select the first row in the New route dialog and use Bulk Insert to enter waypoints separated by commas. Optionally name the route and select save.
references: Page 42, Creating a New Route section

intent_routes.question: How do I add rounding indicators to waypoints?
question_variations: What's the syntax for adding port and starboard indicators?
How do I specify port and starboard in a route?
intent_routes.answer: Add .P for Port or .S for Starboard after the waypoint number (example: 21.S, 22.P, 23.S, 24.P). Adding rounding indicators will convert it to a race route.
references: Page 42, Creating a New Route section

intent_routes.question: How do I convert a track to a route?
question_variations: Can I turn a track into a route?
What's the process for converting tracks to routes?
intent_routes.answer: Convert a track by activating it, then either select the track's pop-up, press the rotary knob, or select the track in the menu. You can also access this through the waypoints tool on the home page.
references: Page 42, Converting Tracks to Routes section

intent_routes.question: What is Dock-to-dock Autorouting?
question_variations: How does Dock-to-dock Autorouting work?
What does Easy Routing do?
intent_routes.answer: Dock-to-dock Autorouting and Easy Routing suggest route positions based on map data and boat dimensions. Boat draught, width, and height must be entered first. These features are for general planning only and should not replace conventional navigation.

intent_routes.question: What charts are compatible with Autorouting?
question_variations: Which maps work with Easy Routing?
What cartography supports Dock-to-dock Autorouting?
intent_routes.answer: Compatible charts include C-MAP MAX-N+, C-MAP Discover, C-MAP Reveal, Navionics+, and Navionics Platinum.

intent_routes.question: How do I delete a route?
question_variations: Can I remove a route?
What's the process to delete a route?
How to erase a route?
intent_routes.answer: You can delete a route in three ways: 1) Select delete from the menu when the route is activated on the panel 2) Select it in the routes dialog and delete it in the edit route dialog 3) Delete all routes at once using the routes dialog

intent_routes.question: What are tracks?
question_variations: Can you explain tracks?
What do tracks show?
What is the purpose of tracks?
intent_routes.answer: Tracks are graphical presentations of your vessel's historical path, showing where your boat has traveled. They allow you to retrace your boat's journey.

intent_routes.question: How do I display tracks on the chart?
question_variations: Why can't I see my tracks?
What's needed to show tracks?
How to make tracks visible?
intent_routes.answer: To display tracks, you must enable both the Display option in the Track dialog AND the Tracks option in the Chart settings dialog.

intent_routes.question: How do I create a new track?
question_variations: Where do I start a new track?
What's the process for creating tracks?
How to begin track recording?
intent_routes.answer: You can create a new track through: 1) Using the Waypoints tool on the Home page and selecting the Tracks tab 2) Selecting New track or Tracks option on the Plot dialog 3) Selecting the Tracks option in the chart menu

intent_routes.question: How do I color tracks?
question_variations: Can I change track colors?
What are the options for coloring tracks?
How to modify track color?
intent_routes.answer: You can color tracks in two ways: 1) Select the track in Tracks dialog and set the color for the entire track in Edit Track dialog 2) Let the system color the track automatically based on source data and high/low settings

intent_routes.question: How do I synchronize my MFD data with B&G app?
question_variations: How can I sync my waypoints with B&G app?
What's the process to synchronize data between MFD and B&G app?
How do I sync routes and tracks with B&G mobile app?
intent_routes.answer: Open Synchronize my data feature from either System Controls dialog or Services settings dialog. Ensure you're connected to internet, sign in with your B&G app account, then select 'Synchronize now' for immediate sync or enable 'Auto Synchronize' for background syncing.
references: Page 45, Synchronizing Data with B&G App section

intent_routes.question: What are the requirements for B&G data synchronization?
question_variations: What do I need to sync with B&G app?
What's required for B&G app synchronization?
Can I sync without internet connection?
intent_routes.answer: You need: 1) An account with B&G mobile app (C-MAP Embark or C-MAP credentials work too), 2) Internet connection on the unit

intent_routes.question: How do I navigate to a cursor position?
question_variations: Can I navigate to cursor location?
What's the process to go to cursor position?
How do I set navigation to cursor?
intent_routes.answer: Position the cursor at your desired destination on any chart, radar, or echosounder panel, then select the 'go to cursor' menu option. Note: This option isn't available if you're already navigating.
references: Navigating section, Navigate to cursor position

intent_routes.question: What data can I synchronize with B&G app?
question_variations: Which items can be synced with B&G app?
What information syncs between MFD and B&G app?
Can I sync my waypoints and routes?
intent_routes.answer: You can synchronize Waypoints, Routes, and Tracks. Note that PredictWind waypoints are not included in the synchronization feature.

intent_routes.question: How do I start Dock-to-dock autorouting?
question_variations: How do I use automatic routing?
What are the steps for dock-to-dock routing?
How can I create an automatic route?
intent_routes.answer: To start Dock-to-dock autorouting: 1) Position at least two routepoints 2) Select Dock-to-dock Autorouting menu option 3) Choose either 'Entire Route' or 'Selection' option 4) Select accept to start routing 5) Review preview mode 6) Select keep to accept the routepoint positions

intent_routes.question: What do the route preview colors mean?
question_variations: How can I tell if a route is safe?
What do red and green routes indicate?
What do the different route colors mean?
intent_routes.answer: For Navionics®, red indicates unsafe areas and green indicates safe areas. For C-MAP, red indicates unsafe areas, yellow indicates dangerous areas, and green indicates safe areas.

intent_routes.question: How do I edit an existing route?
question_variations: Where is the route editor?
How can I modify a route?
How do I access route editing options?
intent_routes.answer: Access the Edit Route dialog by either selecting an active route's pop-up, selecting the route and details option from the menu, or using the Waypoints tool on the Home page and selecting a route. From here you can insert new routepoints, remove points, add bulk waypoints, and set display options.

intent_routes.question: What is the difference between Entire Route and Selection options?
question_variations: When should I use Entire Route vs Selection?
How do the autorouting options differ?
Which autorouting option should I choose?
intent_routes.answer: Entire Route adds new routepoints between the first and last routepoint of the open route. Selection allows you to manually select two routepoints that define the limits for autorouting, discarding any points between your selected start and end points.

intent_routes.question: How do I convert a route to a race route?
question_variations: Can I make my route into a race route?
How do I add rounding indicators?
How do I set up a racing route?
intent_routes.answer: Select the Race option in the Edit Route dialog to convert the route to a race route. The system will automatically add rounding indicators based on the angles. You can then edit the rounding indicators on route waypoints as needed.

intent_routes.question: How do I navigate to a waypoint?
question_variations: How can I go to a waypoint?
What's the process to navigate to a waypoint?
How do I set navigation to a waypoint?
intent_routes.answer: You can navigate to a waypoint in two ways: 1) From the chart - position cursor at destination and select 'go to cursor' from menu, or 2) Using waypoint dialog - select waypoint and click 'Goto' button

intent_routes.question: How do I start navigating a route?
question_variations: How do I begin route navigation?
What's the process to start a route?
How can I activate a route?
intent_routes.answer: To start navigating a route from the chart panel: 1) Activate the route on the panel 2) Select route navigation from the menu 3) Optionally select a route point to start from that position
references: Section: Starting a Route from the Chart Panel

intent_routes.question: What happens with the autopilot when starting navigation?
question_variations: Does autopilot engage automatically during navigation?
How does autopilot work with navigation?
Will I be prompted to use autopilot?
intent_routes.answer: When starting navigation, you'll be prompted to set autopilot to navigation mode, unless boat type is set to SAIL. You can choose not to engage autopilot and set it later via the Autopilot Controller.

intent_routes.question: What options are available during route navigation?
question_variations: What can I do while navigating a route?
What route navigation controls are there?
How can I modify active route navigation?
intent_routes.answer: During route navigation, the expanded menu shows options to: Cancel navigation, Skip a waypoint, and Restart the route from current vessel position

intent_routes.question: What is the default arrival radius?
question_variations: How large is the arrival radius?
What's the standard arrival radius setting?
What arrival radius is preset?
intent_routes.answer: The default arrival radius is 0.05 NM (nautical miles)

intent_routes.question: What is a Rhumb Line in navigation?
question_variations: Can you explain Rhumb Lines?
How do Rhumb Lines work?
What's the definition of a Rhumb Line?
intent_routes.answer: Rhumb lines are tracks of constant bearing that allow travel between two locations. While easier to follow manually, they usually result in longer distances compared to Great circle routes.

intent_routes.question: What is the Arrival Radius?
question_variations: How does Arrival Radius work?
What does Arrival Radius mean?
When is the arrival radius used?
intent_routes.answer: Arrival Radius is an invisible circle around the destination waypoint that determines when a vessel is considered to have arrived. When navigating a route, it defines when a turn is initiated. The radius should be adjusted based on boat speed - higher speeds require wider circles.

intent_routes.question: What happens when you exceed the XTE Limit?
question_variations: What is XTE Limit?
How does XTE Limit work?
When does XTE Limit alarm trigger?
intent_routes.answer: When a vessel deviates from the selected route beyond the defined XTE Limit, an alarm is automatically activated.

intent_routes.question: How does the Arrival Alarm function?
question_variations: When does the Arrival Alarm activate?
What triggers the Arrival Alarm?
How do I use the Arrival Alarm?
intent_routes.answer: The Arrival Alarm, when enabled, activates when the vessel either reaches the waypoint or enters the specified arrival radius.

intent_routes.question: What is Magnetic Variation?
question_variations: How does Magnetic Variation work?
Can you explain Magnetic Variation?
What causes Magnetic Variation?
intent_routes.answer: Magnetic variation is the difference between true bearings and magnetic bearings, caused by different locations of Geographic and Magnetic north poles. The system can automatically convert magnetic north to true north in Auto mode, or manual variation can be entered.

intent_routes.question: What datum format does the system use?
question_variations: Which datum system is used?
Can I change the datum format?
What is the default datum?
intent_routes.answer: The system uses the WGS datum format by default, which is standard for cartography and satellite navigation including GPS. The datum format can be changed to match other systems.

intent_routes.question: How do I change data fields in the SailSteer panel?
question_variations: How can I customize the SailSteer display?
What's the process to edit SailSteer fields?
How do I modify SailSteer panel information?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Select SailSteer panel to make it active 2. Press MENU and select edit option 3. Select instrument field to change (highlighted frame appears) 4. Press MENU again and select info 5. Repeat for other fields 6. Save settings through menu option

intent_routes.question: What does the -S extension mean in navigation calculations?
question_variations: What's the meaning of -S in DTW-S?
Why do some navigation times have -S added?
What's the difference between regular and -S calculations?
intent_routes.answer: The -S extension indicates Sailing calculations that take into account layline courses to waypoints. This applies to DTW-S (Sailing Distance to Waypoint), TTW-S (Sailing Time to Waypoint), and ETA-S (Sailing Estimated Time of Arrival)

intent_routes.question: How do I display the SailSteer overlay on charts?
question_variations: Can I show SailSteer data on my chart?
How to enable SailSteer overlay?
Where do I turn on chart SailSteer overlay?
intent_routes.answer: Toggle the SailSteer overlay on/off in the Chart setting dialog. Note that it won't show when cursor is active or when panning, and if both SailSteer and autopilot compass overlays are enabled, only SailSteer will display

intent_routes.question: What coordinate system does the device use?
question_variations: Which datum format is used?
What's the default navigation datum?
What GPS format does the system use?
intent_routes.answer: The system uses WGS datum format, which is the standard for cartography and satellite navigation including GPS. The datum format can be changed to match other systems

intent_routes.question: What information does the SailSteer panel show?
question_variations: What data can I see on SailSteer?
What's displayed in the SailSteer view?
What sailing data does SailSteer provide?
intent_routes.answer: SailSteer shows composite sailing data relative to yacht's bow including: boat speed, TWA (True Wind Angle), TWS (True Wind Speed), TWD (True Wind Direction), waypoint bearing, depth, heading, COG, apparent wind, laylines, rudder angle, tide information, and user-configurable data fields

intent_routes.question: How do I display the SailSteer overlay?
question_variations: Where is the SailSteer overlay?
How can I see SailSteer?
What settings show SailSteer overlay?
intent_routes.answer: Select the clear cursor option to display the SailSteer overlay. Note that if Look ahead is selected, Heading up orientation must also be selected. Without Look ahead selected, SailSteer displays with all orientations (North up, Heading up, and Course up).

intent_routes.question: What can I do with the Race panel?
question_variations: What are the Race panel features?
What functions does the Race panel have?
How do I use the Race panel?
intent_routes.answer: The Race panel allows you to: display and control the race timer, create and manage the race start line, display race start line data, display the race start line in a chart diagram, and display tactical information for current or next leg.

intent_routes.question: How do I access the Race panel?
question_variations: Where is the Race panel?
How do I open the Race panel?
How can I find the Race panel?
intent_routes.answer: Select the Race button on the Home page to display the Race panel.

intent_routes.question: What information is shown on the Start Line Data panel?
question_variations: What data does the Start Line panel display?
What can I see in Start Line Data?
What information is available in Start Line Data?
intent_routes.answer: The Start Line Data panel shows: boat distance from the start line, tide direction, recommended start end bias, bias advantage in degrees and distance, DIST P (distance to port end), DIST BEHIND LINE (perpendicular distance), DIST S (distance to starboard end), BIAS angle, RACE TIMER, and BIAS ADV (in meters or boat lengths).

intent_routes.question: What do the different start line colors mean?
question_variations: How do I interpret start line colors?
What are the start line color indicators?
What do start line colors indicate?
intent_routes.answer: Blue indicates a square line with no bias advantage. Red with arrow left indicates port end bias. Green with arrow right indicates starboard end bias.

intent_routes.question: How do I set up start line end points by pinging?
question_variations: What's the process for pinging start line ends?
How do I use ping method for start line setup?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Approach port end of start line 2. Open menu and select Start Line > Port end > Ping port 3. Approach starboard end 4. Select Start Line > Starboard end > Ping Starboard. Port end will show solid red and starboard end solid green when set.
references: Race Panel - Start Line Setup Section

intent_routes.question: What data is shown on the start line panel?
question_variations: What information can I see on the start line display?
What measurements are shown on start line panel?
intent_routes.answer: The start line panel displays: DIST P (Distance to port end), DIST BEHIND LINE (Perpendicular distance to start line), DIST S (Distance to starboard end), BIAS (Start line bias angle), RACE TIMER, and BIAS ADV (Bias advantage in meters/boat lengths)
references: Data Displayed on Start Line Panel Section

intent_routes.question: What are the different methods for setting start line ends?
question_variations: How many ways can I set start line ends?
What options do I have for setting start line endpoints?
intent_routes.answer: There are 5 methods: 1. Ping 2. Set at cursor position 3. Specify coordinates 4. Set one based on the other 5. Edit waypoints to create start line end points
references: Menu Options for Setting Start Line Ends Section

intent_routes.question: How do I set start line ends using cursor position?
question_variations: What's the process for setting line ends with cursor?
Can I set start line ends using the chart cursor?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Open Chart panel 2. Move cursor to desired port end position 3. Select Start line > Port end > Set at cursor 4. Repeat process for starboard end point
references: Setting End Points at Cursor Position Section

intent_routes.question: What do the different start line colors mean?
question_variations: How do I interpret start line colors?
What's the meaning of start line color indicators?
intent_routes.answer: Blue square line indicates no bias advantage, Red with arrow left indicates Port end bias, Green with arrow right indicates Starboard end bias

intent_routes.question: How do I set the start line end points?
question_variations: How can I configure start line endpoints?
What's the process for setting up start line points?
How do I set port and starboard endpoints?
intent_routes.answer: You can set start line end points in two ways: 1) Using coordinates - select 'Set coordinate Port' and 'Set coordinate Starboard' menu options to enter specific coordinates, or 2) Setting from each other - use 'Set from stbd Port' and 'Set from port Starboard' options to set Range and Bearing relative to each other.

intent_routes.question: How do I remove the start line?
question_variations: Can I delete the start line?
What's the way to clear start line points?
How to remove start points?
intent_routes.answer: Use the 'Clear Port' or 'Clear Starboard' menu options to remove the start points individually. When both port and starboard points are removed, the entire start line is removed.

intent_routes.question: What information is shown on the Start Line display?
question_variations: What can I see in the Start Line panel?
What data appears in the start line view?
What's displayed on the start line screen?
intent_routes.answer: The Start Line display shows: configured start line to scale, your boat position, distance to line, position relative to laylines, start settings, distance to port and starboard ends, bias angle, tide arrow, extension line, and race timer. When available, it may also show a Zero Burn line indicating optimal distance from the starting line.

intent_routes.question: How do I show measurements in boat lengths?
question_variations: Can I see distances in boat lengths?
How to switch to boat length measurements?
How do I change units to boat lengths?
intent_routes.answer: Select the 'Use boat lengths' setting to show the distance behind the line and Bias advantage in boat length measurements on the Start line panel. This gives a clearer indication of the distance from your boat to the start line.

intent_routes.question: What is the What if? feature?
question_variations: How does the What if feature work?
What does What if do?
How can I use What if?
intent_routes.answer: The What if? feature is a tool that displays navigation data in the Race panel and allows you to change variables to see potential outcomes. You can enter parameters for wind and tide to assess how data might change for the leg, helping predict effects of changing conditions.

intent_routes.question: How do I start the race timer?
question_variations: Where is the start button for race timer?
How to begin race countdown?
How do I activate the race timer?
intent_routes.answer: Access the Race timer controls through the Race panel menu or Trip Calculator. Click the Start button to begin the countdown.

intent_routes.question: What format is the race timer displayed in?
question_variations: How are race timer numbers shown?
What's the time format for race timer?
How do I read the race timer display?
intent_routes.answer: Timer set value is shown in hh:mm format, while the timer counter displays in mm:ss with hours shown to the right of minutes and seconds

intent_routes.question: Where can I find the race timer display?
question_variations: How do I access the race timer?
Which menu shows the race timer?
Where is race timer located?
intent_routes.answer: The Race timer can be displayed from either the Race panel menu or by selecting Trip Calculator from the Tools panel

intent_routes.question: What functions are available in race timer?
question_variations: What can the race timer do?
What are the race timer features?
What operations can I perform with race timer?
intent_routes.answer: Race timer functions include countdown to zero, count up from zero, start, stop, reset, sync, and setting specific start values. It also features rolling timer and auto start trip options.

intent_routes.question: How do I reset the race timer?
question_variations: Can I reset the race timer?
What's the procedure to reset race timer?
How to restart race timer?
intent_routes.answer: Access the Race timer controls and click the Reset button. The default reset value is (00:01:00) but can be changed through Set start value option.

intent_routes.question: How do I start the timer?
question_variations: How to start timing?
Can I start the timer?
What button starts the timer?
intent_routes.answer: Select the Start button. If a time value is preset, it will count down. If start value is set to zero (00:00), it will count up to record elapsed time.

intent_routes.question: What does the Reset button do?
question_variations: How does Reset work?
What happens when I hit Reset?
Can I reset the timer while it's running?
intent_routes.answer: Reset returns the timer to the start value. If the timer is running when Reset is selected, it continues to run from the start value.

intent_routes.question: What is the Sync function?
question_variations: How does Sync work?
When should I use Sync?
What does the Sync button do?
intent_routes.answer: When the timer is counting down, selecting Sync synchronizes the time up or down to the nearest full minute.

intent_routes.question: How does Auto Start Trip work?
question_variations: What is Auto Start Trip?
When does Auto Start Trip begin recording?
How to use Auto Start Trip feature?
intent_routes.answer: When Auto Start Trip is selected, the Trip Log automatically records your time and mileage from the moment the countdown timer begins counting up from zero.

intent_routes.question: What is Rolling Timer?
question_variations: How does Rolling Timer work?
What does the Rolling Timer feature do?
Can the timer automatically restart?
intent_routes.answer: When Rolling Timer is selected, the timer automatically restarts the countdown every time it reaches zero. This continues until the timer is manually stopped.

intent_routes.question: How do I change the data shown in Time Plot?
question_variations: Can I customize Time Plot data?
How to select different data for Time Plot?
How to edit Time Plot information?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Select edit option from menu 2. Activate the field you want to edit 3. Change the information type and range 4. Save your changes

intent_routes.question: What happens when data is missing in the plots?
question_variations: How are data gaps shown in plots?
What indicates missing data in plots?
How does the system handle missing data?
intent_routes.answer: When data is unavailable, the plot shows a dashed line that flattens at the point where data was lost. When data returns, a dashed line connects the points showing an average trend line across the gap.
references: Time and Wind Plots section, Missing Data

intent_routes.question: How do I show or hide the tack bar?
question_variations: Where is the tack bar setting?
Can I turn off the tack bar?
How to enable tack bar display?
intent_routes.answer: The tack bar can be shown or hidden using the Show option in the Tack Bar menu

intent_routes.question: What information does the tack bar show?
question_variations: What can I see on the tack bar?
What data appears in the tack bar?
What is displayed in the tack bar?
intent_routes.answer: The tack bar shows which tack you are currently sailing on and a point of sail/pre-start status bar corresponding to the recorded time data. It uses the same time scale as the main Wind Plot window.

intent_routes.question: How do I adjust the trend averaging?
question_variations: What are the trend averaging settings?
How to change trend line smoothing?
What does trend averaging do?
intent_routes.answer: Trend averaging can be set to Low, Medium, or High. Low shows highest detail closest to raw data, High shows smoothest trend with maximum damping, and Medium provides a balance between raw and damped data.
references: Page 60, Setting up the page section

intent_routes.question: What are the TWD display options?
question_variations: How can I customize the TWD display?
What TWD settings are available?
How to change TWD visualization?
intent_routes.answer: TWD display options include: showing TWD only, TWD trend only, or both TWD and trend; showing/hiding the TWD average line; and enabling tack colors (starboard green/port red) or constant blue color.

intent_routes.question: How do I view tack averages?
question_variations: Where can I find tack average data?
How to see tack performance statistics?
Where are the tack statistics shown?
intent_routes.answer: Select 'Tack Averages' to display a table showing TWA, TWD, TWS, Boat Speed, and Heading averages for both Port and Starboard tacks over the current time period.

intent_routes.question: What is the combined view used for?
question_variations: Why would I use combined view?
What's the purpose of combined view?
How does combined view work?
intent_routes.answer: The combined view allows you to use the Wind Plot in a smaller panel while simultaneously viewing other windows like charts
references: Time and Wind plots section, p.61

intent_routes.question: Can PredictWind weather be shown on charts?
question_variations: How do I display PredictWind on my charts?
Is it possible to see PredictWind weather on the chart display?
Where can I view PredictWind data?
intent_routes.answer: Yes, both PredictWind weather and PredictWind routes can be displayed on charts

intent_routes.question: What wind information is shown in the display?
question_variations: How can I see wind speed and direction?
What wind data is available?
Where do I find TWD and TWS readings?
intent_routes.answer: The display shows True Wind Direction (TWD) at 251 degrees magnetic and True Wind Speed (TWS) at 15.7 knots
references: Time and Wind plots section, p.61

intent_routes.question: How do I display PredictWind weather on my chart?
question_variations: How can I show weather overlay on my chart?
How do I enable PredictWind overlay?
What steps do I need to show weather on my chart?
intent_routes.answer: Turn on GRIB weather overlay from the Chart menu, enter your PredictWind login credentials, and then either download files automatically/manually or import from storage device.
models: All navigation units with PredictWind compatibility

intent_routes.question: What subscription do I need for PredictWind weather?
question_variations: Do I need a subscription for PredictWind?
Is PredictWind subscription required?
intent_routes.answer: An appropriate PredictWind subscription is required to use the weather overlay functionality. Visit www.predictwind.com for subscription details.
models: All navigation units with PredictWind compatibility

intent_routes.question: How do I automatically download PredictWind files?
question_variations: Can PredictWind files download automatically?
What are the automatic download options for PredictWind?
intent_routes.answer: Enter PredictWind login credentials and specify automatic download for either High resolution, Offshore (lower resolution), or both options in the system settings.
models: All navigation units with PredictWind compatibility

intent_routes.question: How do I manually download PredictWind weather files?
question_variations: What's the process for manual PredictWind downloads?
Can I manually download weather files?
intent_routes.answer: Use the Download forecast option in the Chart menu after entering your PredictWind login credentials.
models: All navigation units with PredictWind compatibility

intent_routes.question: Can I use a map memory card to download PredictWind files?
question_variations: Is it safe to download weather files to a map card?
What storage should I use for PredictWind downloads?
intent_routes.answer: No, do not use a map memory card. Downloading files to a map card can corrupt the map card. Use a separate portable storage device instead.
models: All navigation units with PredictWind compatibility

intent_routes.question: How do I turn on GRIB weather overlay?
question_variations: How can I enable GRIB weather overlay?
Where do I find GRIB weather settings?
How do I display GRIB weather on my chart?
intent_routes.answer: Turn on GRIB weather overlay from the chart menu. This will display GRIB weather on the chart and expand the menu to show GRIB weather options.
references: Page 62, Turn on GRIB Weather Overlay section

intent_routes.question: How do I set up PredictWind login credentials?
question_variations: Where do I enter my PredictWind login details?
How do I configure PredictWind account access?
What credentials do I need for PredictWind?
intent_routes.answer: Enter your PredictWind login credentials in the PredictWind GRIB weather dialog, accessed from Chart settings. Enter your email address and password in the respective fields.

intent_routes.question: How do I automatically download PredictWind weather files?
question_variations: Can weather files download automatically?
How to set up automatic weather updates?
Does PredictWind download updates automatically?
intent_routes.answer: Enable automatic download feature to regularly check and download weather updates. You can specify downloading High resolution (requires Professional subscription) or Offshore lower resolution data. Unit must have internet connection and valid PredictWind credentials entered.
references: Page 63, Automatically download PredictWind weather files section

intent_routes.question: How do I manually download PredictWind weather files?
question_variations: Can I download weather files manually?
Where is the manual weather download option?
How to get weather files on demand?
intent_routes.answer: Select Download forecast from Chart menu to open Select forecast type dialog. Choose type and area for download. Requires internet connection, GRIB weather overlay enabled, and valid PredictWind credentials.
references: Page 63, Manually download PredictWind weather files section

intent_routes.question: What types of weather forecasts can I download?
question_variations: Which forecast options are available?
What are the different GRIB download options?
What weather file types can I get?
intent_routes.answer: Two types available: High resolution GRIB for pre-defined areas (requires Professional subscription) and Offshore lower resolution GRIB for any area.

intent_routes.question: How do I download high resolution GRIB weather data?
question_variations: What are the steps to get high res GRIB data?
How can I download detailed weather GRIB files?
intent_routes.answer: Select your location from the Bath High Resolution list, then specify settings including GFS model, wind parameters, and 3-hour time step. Click Download to start the download.

intent_routes.question: What GRIB weather models are available?
question_variations: Which weather forecast models can I choose from?
What are the different GRIB model options?
intent_routes.answer: Available models include PWE (PredictWind European forecast), GFS (Global Forecast System from NOAA), CMCF (Canadian Meteorological Centre Forecast - offshore only), and GFSF (Global Forecast System Forecast - offshore only)

intent_routes.question: How do I download offshore GRIB weather data?
question_variations: What's the process for getting offshore weather GRIBS?
How can I get lower resolution offshore weather data?
intent_routes.answer: Draw a rectangle on the chart by dragging corner markers to select your offshore area. Choose settings including GFS model, wind/pressure parameters, 6-hour time step, 5-day forecast length, and 50km resolution. Click Download.

intent_routes.question: What time steps are available for GRIB downloads?
question_variations: How often can GRIB data be updated?
What are the time interval options for GRIB data?
intent_routes.answer: High resolution GRIB uses 3-hour time steps. Offshore GRIB uses 6-hour time steps. Smaller time steps provide more frequent weather updates but require larger downloads.

intent_routes.question: Where can I see my current GRIB file details?
question_variations: How do I check which GRIB file is active?
Where are my GRIB file specifications shown?
intent_routes.answer: Current GRIB file details are shown in the Forecast menu, displaying filename, date, forecast length in days, and X/Y resolution when a file is active on the chart.

intent_routes.question: How do I check which GRIB file is currently displayed?
question_variations: Where can I see the active GRIB file?
Which GRIB file is showing on my chart?
How do I view current GRIB file details?
intent_routes.answer: Check the GRIB Weather dialog to see the currently displayed file. The active file details will show name, date, duration, and X/Y resolution information.

intent_routes.question: What are the requirements for PredictWind Weather Routing?
question_variations: What do I need to use PredictWind routing?
What's required for weather routing?
How can I set up PredictWind routing?
intent_routes.answer: Requirements include: Internet connection, valid PredictWind subscription/account, PredictWind login credentials entered in settings, and boat performance details entered in the polar table at predictwind.com

intent_routes.question: How do I create a route to cursor using PredictWind?
question_variations: What are the steps to make a cursor route in PredictWind?
Can I create a route to my cursor position?
How do I use the route to cursor feature?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Activate cursor on chart 2. Select PredictWind menu option 3. Choose route to cursor menu option 4. Specify route information 5. Select Download to request new route from PredictWind

intent_routes.question: What happens to expired GRIB files?
question_variations: How does the system handle old GRIB files?
Where do expired GRIB files go?
Can I delete expired GRIB files?
intent_routes.answer: The system automatically moves expired GRIB files (where final forecast time has passed) from available files list to expired files list. You can delete expired files using the 'Delete expired GRIB files' option.

intent_routes.question: How do I import a GRIB file from storage?
question_variations: Can I import GRIB files from external storage?
What's the process to import GRIB files?
How do I load GRIB files from a storage device?
intent_routes.answer: Select the Import file option in the GRIB Weather dialog to import a GRIB file from a storage device or any directory available to the File manager. Note that imported GRIB data overwrites existing GRIB data in memory.

intent_routes.question: How do I set departure spacing in PredictWind?
question_variations: What are the departure time options in PredictWind?
How can I space my departures in PredictWind?
What time intervals can I choose for departures?
intent_routes.answer: You can space departures by 1 hour, 3 hours, 6 hours, 12 hours or 24 hours using the Departure Options menu

intent_routes.question: Where can I view my route download status?
question_variations: How do I check if my route is still downloading?
Where are my route transfers shown?
How can I see download progress for routes?
intent_routes.answer: Select the Files icon on the Tool panel, then select Transfers to view the status of route downloads

intent_routes.question: When is it unsafe to use autopilot?
question_variations: In what conditions should I avoid using autopilot?
What are the restrictions for autopilot use?
Where is autopilot operation prohibited?
intent_routes.answer: Do not use autopilot in heavy traffic areas, narrow waters, poor visibility, extreme sea conditions, or areas where autopilot use is prohibited by law

intent_routes.question: What safety precautions should I take when using autopilot?
question_variations: How do I safely operate the autopilot?
What are the autopilot safety guidelines?
What should I remember when using autopilot?
intent_routes.answer: Never leave helm unattended, keep magnetic materials away from heading sensor, regularly verify course and position, switch to standby and reduce speed in hazardous situations, ensure physical standby key is available

intent_routes.question: How do I view detailed routing information?
question_variations: Where can I find my route summary?
How do I access PredictWind routing details?
Where are route details displayed?
intent_routes.answer: Select the Summary option in the PredictWind menu to view detailed routing information including start time, finish time, time taken, and wind speed data

intent_routes.question: How do I start a new PredictWind route to a waypoint?
question_variations: What are the steps to create a PredictWind route?
How can I generate a route using PredictWind?
What's the process for making a waypoint route in PredictWind?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Select waypoint via Find menu, waypoints toolbar button, or chart selection 2. Open Edit Waypoint dialog 3. Select PredictWind 4. Enter routing information 5. Select Download to request the route

intent_routes.question: What are the PredictWind routing mode options?
question_variations: What routing modes does PredictWind offer?
Which routing modes can I choose from?
What are the different types of PredictWind routing?
intent_routes.answer: PredictWind offers three routing modes: 1. Routing - for standard route planning with wind/swell avoidance options 2. Departure Planning - for spacing departures and selecting forecast models 3. Destination Forecast - for requesting destination weather information

intent_routes.question: How do I adjust the polar speed in PredictWind?
question_variations: Can I modify the polar speed settings?
What's the process for changing polar speed?
How do I change boat speed calculations in PredictWind?
intent_routes.answer: Adjust the polar speed by entering a percentage in the Polar Speed Adjustment setting. For example, enter 80% if you expect the boat to perform 20% slower than your polar. Note: The polar must be pre-selected in your online PredictWind Account settings at PredictWind.com

intent_routes.question: What are the light wind motoring options?
question_variations: How do I set up light wind motoring?
What settings are available for light wind motoring?
How does light wind motoring work?
intent_routes.answer: Light wind motoring options allow you to specify: 1. Motoring speed 2. The wind speed threshold at which you would stop sailing and start motoring

intent_routes.question: Where does routing start from?
question_variations: What are the routing start options?
Can I choose where to start the route?
How do I select the routing start point?
intent_routes.answer: You can start routing from either: 1. Current vessel position or 2. First waypoint in the route. This is specified in the 'Start Routing At' setting

intent_routes.question: How do I engage the autopilot?
question_variations: How do I turn on autopilot?
How do I activate the autopilot?
What's the process to start autopilot?
intent_routes.answer: To engage the autopilot, either select the engage button to activate the last active mode, or select the mode button to display and choose from available modes

intent_routes.question: How do I disengage the autopilot?
question_variations: How do I turn off autopilot?
How do I deactivate autopilot?
How do I switch autopilot off?
intent_routes.answer: To disengage the autopilot, select the standby button. When in standby, the boat must be steered manually

intent_routes.question: What is NFU mode in autopilot?
question_variations: How does Non-Follow Up mode work?
What does NFU mode do?
Explain NFU autopilot mode
intent_routes.answer: Non-Follow Up (NFU) mode uses port and starboard buttons to control the rudder. This mode is activated by selecting the port or starboard button when the autopilot is in standby

intent_routes.question: How does Follow-Up mode work?
question_variations: What is FU mode in autopilot?
How do I use Follow-Up mode?
Explain Follow-Up autopilot mode
intent_routes.answer: In Follow-Up (FU) mode, the rudder moves to and maintains a set rudder angle. To change the set rudder angle, either select port/starboard buttons or turn the rotary knob with autopilot controller active

intent_routes.question: What is Heading hold mode?
question_variations: How does Heading hold mode work?
What does mode A do in autopilot?
Explain Heading hold autopilot mode
intent_routes.answer: In Heading hold mode (A), the autopilot steers the vessel on a set heading. When activated, it uses current compass heading as the set heading. Note that it doesn't compensate for drift from current or wind

intent_routes.question: How do I change heading in Heading hold mode?
question_variations: How can I adjust the heading?
What's the process to change heading?
How do I modify heading while in Heading hold?
intent_routes.answer: To change the set heading, either select a port or starboard button, or turn the rotary knob with the autopilot controller active. The heading change happens immediately and maintains until a new heading is set

intent_routes.question: How do I perform a tack in Heading hold mode?
question_variations: What's the process for tacking?
How can I initiate a tack?
What's the tacking procedure?
intent_routes.answer: To initiate a tack, select the tack button in the mode list, then select the tack direction. Note: Only available for sail boats and should be tested in calm conditions with light wind
references: Page 70, Tacking in Heading Hold Mode Section

intent_routes.question: How do I change the wind reference angle on autopilot?
question_variations: How can I adjust the wind angle?
What's the process to modify wind reference angle?
How do you change wind angle on autopilot?
intent_routes.answer: Select a port or starboard button, then with the autopilot controller active, turn the rotary knob. The change in wind reference angle occurs immediately.

intent_routes.question: What are the requirements for tacking in wind mode?
question_variations: When can I tack in wind mode?
What conditions are needed for tacking?
intent_routes.answer: The true wind angle must be less than 90 degrees for tacking. The rate of turn is determined by the tack time setting in autopilot settings.

intent_routes.question: What are the requirements for gybing in wind mode?
question_variations: When can I gybe in wind mode?
What conditions are needed for gybing?
intent_routes.answer: The true wind angle must be more than 120 degrees for gybing. The rate of turn is determined by the tack time setting in autopilot settings.

intent_routes.question: How do I initiate a tack or gybe?
question_variations: What's the process to start tacking?
How do you begin a tack maneuver?
intent_routes.answer: Select the Tack/Gybe option in the mode list. Note that the autopilot will temporarily add a 5° bear-away on the new tack to allow the boat to pick up speed before returning to the set angle.

intent_routes.question: What are the performance levels of the autopilot?
question_variations: How many performance modes are there?
What's the difference between autopilot performance levels?
intent_routes.answer: There are five performance levels. Level one uses least power with slowest response, while level five uses most power with highest response. The current performance mode is shown in the top right corner of the Autopilot controller status display.

intent_routes.question: What is the tack angle range in Heading hold mode?
question_variations: What angles can I set for tacking?
What's the available range for tack angles?
intent_routes.answer: The tack angle can be set between 50 degrees and 150 degrees in Heading hold mode.

intent_routes.question: How do I initiate a tack in NoDrift mode?
question_variations: How can I tack the boat in NoDrift?
What's the process for tacking with autopilot?
How to perform a tack maneuver?
intent_routes.answer: Select the tack button in the mode list, then select the tack direction

intent_routes.question: What is NoDrift mode?
question_variations: How does NoDrift mode work?
Can you explain NoDrift autopilot mode?
What does NoDrift mode do?
intent_routes.answer: NoDrift mode steers the vessel along a calculated track line from present position in a user-set direction. The autopilot draws an invisible track line based on current heading and uses position information to calculate cross track distance, automatically steering along the calculated track.

intent_routes.question: How do I change the track line in NoDrift mode?
question_variations: Can I adjust the track line?
What's the process to modify track line?
How to alter course in NoDrift?
intent_routes.answer: Select a port or starboard button, then with the autopilot controller active, turn the rotary knob

intent_routes.question: What is NAV mode?
question_variations: How does Navigation mode work?
Can you explain NAV mode?
What does NAV mode do?
intent_routes.answer: NAV mode automatically steers the vessel to a specific waypoint location or along a pre-defined route. It uses position information to adjust course and keep the vessel on the track line to the destination waypoint.

intent_routes.question: When should NAV mode not be used?
question_variations: Is NAV mode safe for sailing?
What are the restrictions for NAV mode?
Can I use NAV mode while sailing?
intent_routes.answer: NAV mode should only be used in open waters and must not be used while sailing, as course changes may result in unexpected tacks or gybes.

intent_routes.question: What options are available in NAV mode?
question_variations: What can I do in NAV mode?
What are the NAV mode controls?
What buttons are available in NAV mode?
intent_routes.answer: NAV mode offers three options: Restart (restarts navigation from current position), Skip (skips active waypoint for next one), and Cancel (switches to heading hold mode while maintaining current navigation)

intent_routes.question: What is Wind mode?
question_variations: How does Wind mode work?
Can you explain Wind mode?
What does Wind mode do?
intent_routes.answer: Wind mode captures the current wind angle as steering reference and adjusts the boat's heading to maintain this wind angle. It's only available when boat type is set to Sail and requires wind information.

intent_routes.question: How do I change the wind reference angle?
question_variations: Can I adjust the wind angle?
How to modify wind reference?
What's the process to change wind angle?
intent_routes.answer: Select a port or starboard button, then with the autopilot controller active, turn the rotary knob. The change in wind reference angle takes place immediately.

intent_routes.question: What are the tack angle limits for the autopilot in Heading hold mode?
question_variations: What is the tack angle range?
How far can the boat tack in Heading hold mode?
What are the minimum and maximum tack angles?
intent_routes.answer: The tack angle can be set between 50 degrees and 150 degrees in Heading hold mode

intent_routes.question: How does the Auto wind function work?
question_variations: When does the autopilot use AWA vs TWA?
What is the Auto wind function setting?
How does wind mode selection work in Auto?
intent_routes.answer: In Auto wind function, the system uses AWA (Apparent Wind Angle) when TWA is less than 70 degrees, and uses TWA (True Wind Angle) when TWA is 70 degrees or greater

intent_routes.question: What is the Auto response setting in autopilot steering?
question_variations: How does Auto response work?
What are the different Auto response modes?
How does the autopilot react to environmental changes?
intent_routes.answer: Auto response controls how the autopilot reacts to environmental influences. It has four modes: Off (remains in selected response mode), Economy (requires large changes), Normal (requires moderate changes), and Sport (most sensitive with automatic response rate increases)

intent_routes.question: How does the Recovery setting work?
question_variations: What does the Recovery setting do?
How does autopilot recovery handle course errors?
What are the Recovery mode options?
intent_routes.answer: Recovery sets sensitivity to course errors and reaction to unexpected events like wave or wind shifts. It temporarily increases steering response to maximum (Perf 5) for 15 seconds or until heading error is corrected. Options are: Off, Narrow (most sensitive), Medium, and Wide (least sensitive)

intent_routes.question: When should I use Manual speed setting?
question_variations: What is the Manual speed setting for?
How does Manual speed work in autopilot?
Why would I need to set Manual speed?
intent_routes.answer: Manual speed should be used when boat speed or SOG data is unavailable or unreliable. You can enter a manual value for speed source that the autopilot will use for steering calculations

intent_routes.question: What are the different autopilot response modes?
question_variations: What autopilot sensitivity settings are available?
How can I adjust autopilot responsiveness?
What are the autopilot steering modes?
intent_routes.answer: The autopilot has 4 response modes: Off, Narrow (most sensitive to course changes), Medium (moderate sensitivity), and Wide (least sensitive to course changes). There is also a Manual speed mode when boat speed/SOG data is unavailable.

intent_routes.question: What are the autopilot operational limits?
question_variations: What are the maximum and minimum settings for autopilot?
What are the autopilot parameter boundaries?
What limits apply to autopilot operation?
intent_routes.answer: The autopilot operational limits are: TWA min: 110°, TWA max: 165°, Bear away max: 05°, Cruising Speed: 12 knots, Rudder limit: 45°, Off course limit: 20°

intent_routes.question: How does True Wind Angle Control work?
question_variations: What is TWA control on autopilot?
How does wind angle control function?
What does True Wind Angle Control do?
intent_routes.answer: True Wind Angle Control manages the range where gust and True Wind Speed response operate. It uses TWA min and max settings to define the operational range, and includes bear away max angle for stability control.

intent_routes.question: What is the rudder limit setting?
question_variations: How does rudder limit work?
What does the rudder limit control?
How far can the rudder move under autopilot?
intent_routes.answer: The rudder limit determines maximum rudder movement in degrees from midship position during automatic modes. It only applies during straight course autosteering, not during course changes, and doesn't affect Non-Follow-up steering.

intent_routes.question: What triggers the off course alarm?
question_variations: When does the off course alarm activate?
How is the off course alarm limit set?
What is the off course limit?
intent_routes.answer: The off course alarm is triggered when the vessel deviates from the set course by more than the defined off course limit, which is set to 20 degrees by default.

intent_routes.question: How do I access the autopilot controls?
question_variations: Where is the autopilot menu?
How do I open autopilot settings?
How can I find the autopilot controller?
intent_routes.answer: Switch to the last active page with the autopilot controller open

intent_routes.question: What is rudder gain in autopilot settings?
question_variations: How does rudder gain work?
What does the rudder gain parameter do?
Can you explain rudder gain setting?
intent_routes.answer: Rudder gain determines the ratio between commanded rudder and heading error. Higher values apply more rudder. Too low values result in slow heading error compensation, while too high values cause instability and overshoot.

intent_routes.question: What is the turn rate setting?
question_variations: How do I adjust turn rate?
What does turn rate control?
What is the preferred turn rate setting?
intent_routes.answer: Turn rate sets the preferred turn rate while turning, measured in degrees per minute

intent_routes.question: How does counter rudder work?
question_variations: What is counter rudder?
What does the counter rudder setting do?
How does counter rudder affect steering?
intent_routes.answer: Counter rudder controls the relation between change in heading error and applied rudder. Higher counter rudder reduces applied rudder faster when approaching the set heading.

intent_routes.question: What is auto trim?
question_variations: How does auto trim work?
What does the auto trim setting do?
