intent_routes.answer: Use the Phone tool in the Tools menu to connect a phone to the MFD. Refer to 'Using your phone with the MFD' on page 132 for detailed instructions.

intent_routes.question: How do I acknowledge an alarm?
question_variations: What do I do when an alarm goes off?
How to clear an alarm?
How can I stop the alarm sound?
intent_routes.answer: You can acknowledge an alarm in two ways: 1) Select 'Close' to acknowledge and stop the siren but keep the alarm active in the listing until resolved, or 2) Select 'Disable' to completely turn off that specific alarm setting

intent_routes.question: What do the alarm colors mean?
question_variations: How are alarms classified?
What's the difference between alarm colors?
What do different colored alarms indicate?
intent_routes.answer: Red = Critical alarm, Orange = Important alarm, Yellow = Standard alarm, Blue = Warning, Green = Lite warning

intent_routes.question: How are alarm situations indicated?
question_variations: What happens when there's an alarm?
How do I know when there's an alarm?
What indicates an active alarm?
intent_routes.answer: Alarm situations are indicated by: 1) An alarm pop-up message 2) An alarm icon in the status bar 3) Status bar pulsing with the color of the alarm 4) An audible alarm if siren is enabled

intent_routes.question: What happens when I restore defaults?
question_variations: How do I reset to factory settings?
What does restore defaults do?
Will I lose my waypoints if I restore defaults?
intent_routes.answer: Restoring defaults will reset selected settings to factory values. If waypoints and routes or tracks are selected, they will be permanently deleted. The display will restart and other displays should be powered down.

intent_routes.question: Where do I find active alarms?
question_variations: How do I check current alarms?
Where can I see alarm history?
How to view active alarms?
intent_routes.answer: Active alarms can be accessed through the Alarm settings dialog or by selecting the Alarm button on the toolbar. The list shows all active alarms with details until acknowledged or resolved.

intent_routes.question: How do I update the software on my Zeus 3S?
question_variations: What's the process to update Zeus 3S software?
How can I upgrade my Zeus 3S firmware?
intent_routes.answer: Download the software update from www.bandg.com, transfer it to a compatible storage device, insert the storage device in the unit, and restart the unit to begin the update. Do not add software updates to a chart card.

intent_routes.question: What is the current software version available?
question_variations: Which version can I update to?
What's the latest firmware version?
intent_routes.answer: The available version is 18.3, updating from current version 18.2

intent_routes.question: How do I create a service report?
question_variations: Where can I generate a technical support report?
How do I make a system report?
intent_routes.answer: Use the built-in service assistant to create a report. The report includes software version, serial number, settings information, and can include screenshots and log files. There's a 20MB limit for attachments. Reports can be saved to storage, emailed, or uploaded directly with internet connection.

intent_routes.question: How much storage space is available?
question_variations: What's the remaining storage capacity?
How much free space do I have?
intent_routes.answer: 144.7 GB of free space is available, with 1.3 MB currently used

intent_routes.question: Where can I find my waypoints information?
question_variations: How do I access stored waypoints?
Where are my saved waypoints?
intent_routes.answer: Waypoints can be found in the Storage dialog under the Waypoints section. Currently shows 38 waypoints, 1 deleted waypoint, 33 tracks, and 32 trips.

intent_routes.question: How do I clean the Zeus 3S display screen?
question_variations: What's the proper way to clean the display?
Can I clean the Zeus 3S screen?
What should I use to clean the display unit?
intent_routes.answer: Use a micro-fiber or soft cotton cloth with plenty of water to clean the screen. Spray lightly with fresh water to dissolve salt remains, then wipe dry. Do not apply pressure with the cloth.

intent_routes.question: What cleaning products should I avoid using on the Zeus 3S?
question_variations: Which cleaners are unsafe for the display?
Can I use solvent cleaners on the Zeus?
What cleaning materials damage the display?
intent_routes.answer: Avoid using abrasive cleaning products, solvents (acetone, mineral turpentine), acid, ammonia, alcohol, jet wash or high pressure wash as these can damage the display and plastic housing.

intent_routes.question: How do I update the software on my Zeus 3S?
question_variations: What's the process for updating Zeus software?
Can I update my Zeus 3S firmware?
How do software updates work on Zeus 3S?
intent_routes.answer: When connected to the internet, the system automatically checks for updates. You'll be notified of available updates and can start them from the Updates dialog. Back up user data before updating. Don't turn off the unit during updates until prompted.

intent_routes.question: Where should I store software update files?
question_variations: Can I put update files on a chart card?
What storage should I use for Zeus updates?
Where do I save Zeus 3S update files?
intent_routes.answer: Do not add software update files to a chart card. If internal memory is insufficient, you'll be prompted to insert a memory card or USB storage device.

intent_routes.question: How do I calibrate the touchscreen?
question_variations: Where is the touchscreen calibration setting?
Can I recalibrate my Zeus 3S screen?
What's the process for screen calibration?
intent_routes.answer: Access touchscreen calibration through the system settings menu under Advanced Settings. The system will guide you through automatic calibration.

intent_routes.question: How do I export waypoints from my system?
question_variations: What's the process to export waypoints?
Can I export my waypoints to another device?
How do I transfer waypoints?
intent_routes.answer: To export waypoints: 1. Select the export option from the menu 2. Select the appropriate file format 3. Select the export option to export to the memory card. Use a memory card, not chart cards, for export.

intent_routes.question: What file formats are available for exporting user data?
question_variations: Which export formats can I use?
What are the different export file versions?
intent_routes.answer: Available formats include: User Data File v6 (waypoints, routes, colored tracks), v5 (with UUID), v4 (full system transfer), v3 (with depth), v2 (no depth), and GPX format (no depth, web-compatible)

intent_routes.question: How do I export data from a specific region?
question_variations: Can I export waypoints from just one area?
How to export selected region data?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Select the export region option 2. Drag the boundary box to define the desired region you want to export data from

intent_routes.question: What happens when I purge user data?
question_variations: Can I recover purged data?
Is purged data permanent?
What does purging do to my data?
intent_routes.answer: When user data is purged from memory, it cannot be recovered. Purging deleted data can improve system performance if you have numerous deleted, unpurged user data.

intent_routes.question: How do I import system settings?
question_variations: Can I transfer settings to another unit?
What's the process for importing settings?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Connect a storage device to the unit 2. Browse the memory and select the desired backup file to start the import. Warning: Importing system settings will overwrite all existing system settings.

intent_routes.question: What IP cameras are compatible with Zeus 3S?
question_variations: Which IP cameras work with Zeus 3S?
What camera models can I connect to Zeus 3S?
Are there specific supported IP cameras for Zeus 3S?
intent_routes.answer: The supported IP cameras are: AXIS P1244 A, IP CAM-1, and IRIS S460

intent_routes.question: What are the requirements for adding a camera?
question_variations: How do I connect a camera to Zeus 3S?
What do I need to add a camera to the system?
intent_routes.answer: Camera requirements include: Ethernet connection IP camera, H.264 video format with RTSP streaming, and the camera URL address (and username/password if applicable)

intent_routes.question: Which FLIR cameras are supported?
question_variations: What FLIR models work with Zeus 3S?
Are FLIR cameras compatible with Zeus 3S?
intent_routes.answer: The supported FLIR cameras are: FLIR M232 and FLIR M300 Series

intent_routes.question: How do I control the FLIR camera pan and tilt?
question_variations: What are the FLIR camera movement controls?
How can I move the FLIR camera?
intent_routes.answer: Use the arrow buttons on the video panel - left/right arrows control pan, up/down arrows control tilt. The camera will continue moving while the button is pressed.
references: Section: Panning and tilting the FLIR camera

intent_routes.question: How many FLIR cameras can be connected to the network?
question_variations: Can I connect multiple FLIR cameras?
What's the maximum number of FLIR cameras allowed?
intent_routes.answer: Only one FLIR camera can be connected to the Ethernet network at a time.
references: Section: Establishing connection with the FLIR video camera

intent_routes.question: How does zooming work in FLIR infrared mode?
question_variations: What are the zoom levels in FLIR IR mode?
How do I zoom when using FLIR infrared camera?
intent_routes.answer: In infrared mode, digital zoom is available with 3 levels: 0x, 2x, and 4x zoom. Each press of the zoom button increments or decrements the zoom level.
references: Zooming the FLIR video image section

intent_routes.question: How does FLIR camera zooming work in daylight mode?
question_variations: What type of zoom does FLIR use in daylight?
How do I zoom the FLIR camera in daylight mode?
intent_routes.answer: In daylight mode, optical zoom is available. The camera continues to zoom as long as you hold down the zoom panel button.
references: Zooming the FLIR video image section

intent_routes.question: What color options are available for FLIR infrared view?
question_variations: How can I change FLIR infrared colors?
What are the FLIR thermal color settings?
intent_routes.answer: In infrared mode, you can toggle through different color schemes where each scheme maps different colors to different temperatures. You can also invert the color scheme using the toggle polarity option.
references: The FLIR camera source options section

intent_routes.question: How do I stop the CZone panel from opening at startup?
question_variations: Can I disable CZone auto-start?
Prevent CZone from launching automatically
intent_routes.answer: You can disable the fullscreen CZone panel from opening at startup through the CZone settings dialog. By default, it is now disabled from opening at startup.
references: CZone Panel Disabled from Opening at Startup section

intent_routes.question: What integration options are available for third-party devices?
question_variations: Which external systems can connect to the MFD?
What third party systems are compatible?
intent_routes.answer: The system supports FUSION-Link devices for audio control, NMEA 0183 Interface devices for data conversion, and BEP CZone systems for distributed power system control and monitoring.
references: Integration of 3rd party devices section, page 149

intent_routes.question: How do I enable CZone digital switching on my MFD?
question_variations: How to activate CZone on the display?
Where do I turn on CZone features?
How can I enable CZone control?
intent_routes.answer: Go to Settings > Advanced Settings and select CZone under Digital Switching configurations. The CZone control bar will automatically appear when properly configured.

intent_routes.question: What do the CZone control bar button colors mean?
question_variations: How do I know if a CZone switch is on or off?
What do the different CZone button colors indicate?
How can I tell the status of CZone switches?
intent_routes.answer: Black indicates OFF status, Blue indicates ON status, and Red indicates an error in the switch or communication.

intent_routes.question: How do I remove CZone devices from the control bar?
question_variations: Can I disable CZone devices?
How to hide CZone controls?
What's the process to remove CZone from display?
intent_routes.answer: Open Digital Switching Configurations dialog and either unselect specific devices or select 'None' to remove all CZone devices from the control bar.

intent_routes.question: Where do I find ITC lighting controls?
question_variations: How do I access ITC lighting?
Where are the lighting controls located?
How to control ITC lights?
intent_routes.answer: ITC lighting controls appear in the control bar when properly connected to the NMEA 2000 network. If not visible, activate it through Settings > Advanced Settings > ITC Lighting.

intent_routes.question: What networking system is required for CZone integration?
question_variations: Which network does CZone use?
How is CZone connected to the display?
What network connection does CZone need?
intent_routes.answer: CZone digital switching devices connect to the NMEA 2000 network for integration with the MFD.

intent_routes.question: How do I turn on RGBW lighting?
question_variations: How do I enable the lighting controller?
Where is the RGBW lighting switch?
How to activate vessel lighting control?
intent_routes.answer: Go to Settings > Advanced Settings > Features and enable RGBW Lighting. The lighting controller will then appear in the control bar when properly connected to the NMEA 2000 network.

intent_routes.question: What are the lighting zone controls?
question_variations: How do I control different lighting zones?
What do the lighting control buttons do?
How do I adjust individual light zones?
intent_routes.answer: The lighting control bar includes: Zone management button (A), zone toggle (B), brightness adjustment (C), Quick White mode (D), color adjustment (E), zone on/off switch (F), and mode selection (G) for color fade or music sync.

intent_routes.question: What does Quick White mode do?
question_variations: How does the Quick White function work?
Can I quickly change all lights to white?
intent_routes.answer: Quick White mode instantly turns all unlocked and active zones to white light when selected. Selecting it again returns all zones to their previous state.

intent_routes.question: What lighting modes are available?
question_variations: Which light modes can I select?
What lighting effects are possible?
intent_routes.answer: Two lighting modes are available: Color fade and Music sync. These can be selected using the mode selection button (G) in the control bar.

intent_routes.question: What should I do if the lighting controller shows 'not connected'?
question_variations: Why does it say not connected for lighting?
How do I fix lighting connection issues?
intent_routes.answer: If you see a 'not connected' message, verify the controller supports NMEA 2000 standard and check if the controller is visible in the device list. There may be a connection problem between the MFD and the lighting controller.

intent_routes.question: How do I enable RGBW lighting control?
question_variations: Where do I turn on RGBW lighting?
How to activate the lighting controller?
Where is the RGBW lighting setting?
intent_routes.answer: Go to Settings > Advanced settings > Features and enable RGBW Lighting

intent_routes.question: What does the control bar show when there's no connection?
question_variations: How do I know if the lighting controller is disconnected?
What happens when lighting controller loses connection?
intent_routes.answer: A 'not connected' message displays on the control bar when there is a connection problem between the MFD and lighting controller

intent_routes.question: How do I turn lights on and off?
question_variations: Where is the power button for lights?
How to control individual lights?
intent_routes.answer: Tap the Power button icon next to the lighting zone/individual light label to turn the light on/off. The Power icon shows the selected color when on, and is black and white when off.

intent_routes.question: What are the main control bar elements?
question_variations: What do the buttons on the lighting control bar do?
How do I use the lighting control panel?
intent_routes.answer: The control bar includes: Close button (A), Manage Lights button (B), Off button (C), White button (D), Scenes/All lights list (E), Manage Scene dialog (F), Color preview (G), All lights button (H), and Scenes button (I)

intent_routes.question: How do I apply lighting effects?
question_variations: Where are the lighting effects settings?
Can I create light sequences?
intent_routes.answer: Use the Effects button to customize lighting zones with color sequences, adjust color rate, intensity, color transition, or synchronize lights with music. Start/stop effects from the Effects menu by selecting Start or Stop.

intent_routes.question: How do I create a new lighting zone?
question_variations: What are the steps to create a lighting zone?
Can you tell me how to set up a new zone for lights?
What's the process for adding a lighting zone?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Open the lighting control bar on MFD 2. Select Manage Lights button 3. From Lights tab, select Create New Zone 4. Add zone name, assign controller, and select lights for the zone 5. Select Create

intent_routes.question: How do I create a custom color sequence?
question_variations: What are the steps to make a color sequence?
How can I program a custom light sequence?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Select lighting zone label 2. Select Effects button 3. Select color block 4. Select Create 5. Select Add 6. Use color/hue sliders and select check mark 7. Repeat steps 5-6 for more colors 8. Select Back when finished

intent_routes.question: How do I delete a lighting sequence?
question_variations: What's the way to remove a sequence?
Can I delete a light sequence?
intent_routes.answer: Tap the sequence (tap twice if not currently selected), then select Delete

intent_routes.question: How do I delete a lighting zone?
question_variations: What's the process to remove a zone?
Can I delete a lighting zone?
intent_routes.answer: Select the zone in the Manage Lights dialog, then in the Zone Details dialog, select Delete This Zone

intent_routes.question: How do I stop a lighting effect?
question_variations: What's the way to stop an effect?
Can I stop a light effect without turning off lights?
intent_routes.answer: Open the running effect and select Stop. This stops the effect without turning off the zone lighting

intent_routes.question: What can I adjust in the effect program menu?
question_variations: What settings are available for lighting effects?
What can I customize in the effects menu?
intent_routes.answer: You can adjust Transition (color transition type), Intensity (brightness level), Rate (program effect change speed), and Color Rate (color change speed)

intent_routes.question: How do I create a new lighting scene?
question_variations: What are the steps to make a new scene?
How can I set up a lighting scene?
What's the process for creating a scene?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Select Scenes button from lighting control bar 2. Select Create New Scene 3. Enter scene name 4. Select lights to assign 5. Use Configure button to customize lights 6. Select Save

intent_routes.question: What settings can I adjust in the Manage Effects dialog?
question_variations: What options are in Manage Effects?
What can I control in the effects dialog?
What lighting parameters can I modify?
intent_routes.answer: The Manage Effects dialog includes: State (on/off), Program (lighting effect), Colors (color sequence), Transition (color transition), Intensity (effect strength), and Rate (program change speed)

intent_routes.question: How do I edit an existing scene?
question_variations: Can I modify a scene after creating it?
What's the process to change a scene?
How do I update a lighting scene?
intent_routes.answer: From the lighting control panel, navigate to the scene, select the ellipsis icon to open Manage Scene dialog, make desired lighting changes, then select Save

intent_routes.question: How do I delete a zone?
question_variations: What's the process to remove a zone?
Can I delete a lighting zone?
How do I get rid of a zone?
intent_routes.answer: Open the Zone Details dialog and select Delete This Zone option

intent_routes.question: How do I control an individual light?
question_variations: Can I operate a single light?
How do I adjust one light separately?
What's needed to control lights individually?
intent_routes.answer: To control a light individually, it must first be removed from its zone

intent_routes.question: How do I zoom in on the chart display?
question_variations: What gesture zooms in on charts?
How can I make the chart bigger?
What is the zoom in gesture?
intent_routes.answer: Use a spread gesture (moving fingers apart) to zoom in on the chart or images. Note that this gesture is not available for zooming sonar images.

intent_routes.question: How do I zoom out on the chart?
question_variations: What gesture reduces chart size?
How do I make the chart smaller?
What is the zoom out gesture?
intent_routes.answer: Use a pinch gesture (moving fingers together) to zoom out on the chart or images. Note that this gesture is not available for zooming sonar images.

intent_routes.question: How do I quickly scroll through the waypoint list?
question_variations: What's the fastest way to scroll waypoints?
Can I speed scroll through waypoints?
How to scroll waypoint list quickly?
intent_routes.answer: Use a flick gesture to quickly scroll through the waypoint list. Tap the screen to stop the scrolling.

intent_routes.question: What happens when I press and hold a panel button?
question_variations: How long do I hold panel buttons?
What does holding a panel button do?
How do I see split screen options?
intent_routes.answer: Press and hold a panel button on the home page for 3 seconds to see available split screen options.

intent_routes.question: How do I edit favorite buttons?
question_variations: What happens when I press and hold favorites?
How can I modify favorite buttons?
How do I enter favorites edit mode?
intent_routes.answer: Press and hold on a favorite button on the home page to enter edit mode.

intent_routes.question: How do I zoom in on the chart display?
question_variations: What is the zoom in gesture?
How can I make the chart bigger?
What's the command to zoom in?
intent_routes.answer: You can either spread your fingers on the touchscreen or press the + key on the keyboard to zoom in on charts and images. Note that touch zoom is not available for sonar images.

intent_routes.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the Chart page?
question_variations: How do I access charts with keyboard?
Which key shows the chart display?
intent_routes.answer: Press F2 or Ctrl + H to open the Chart page

intent_routes.question: How do I take a screenshot?
question_variations: What's the keyboard shortcut for screenshots?
How can I capture the screen?
intent_routes.answer: Press either Ctrl + \ or the PrintScn key to take a screenshot

intent_routes.question: How do I place a MOB (Man Overboard) mark?
question_variations: What's the MOB shortcut?
How do I mark man overboard position?
intent_routes.answer: Press and hold F12 to position a MOB mark at the vessel position

intent_routes.question: How do I center the chart on my vessel?
question_variations: What's the shortcut to center on vessel?
How do I find my boat position on chart?
intent_routes.answer: Press Ctrl + B to center the chart on vessel position

intent_routes.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the System Controls?
question_variations: How do I access system controls?
Which key combination shows system settings?
intent_routes.answer: Press Ctrl + Q to open the System Controls dialog

intent_routes.question: How do I switch between panels on a split screen?
question_variations: What's the shortcut to change active panel?
How do I move between multiple panels?
intent_routes.answer: Press Ctrl + D to switch between panels on a multi-panel page

intent_routes.question: What gestures can I use on the touchscreen?
question_variations: How do touch controls work?
What touch commands are available?
intent_routes.answer: You can tap to stop scrolling, pan to position charts/images, pinch to zoom out, and spread to zoom in. Note that touch zooming is not available for sonar images.

intent_routes.question: How do I pause the radar?
question_variations: Can I stop the radar temporarily?
What's the way to pause radar operation?
Where is the radar pause function?
intent_routes.answer: Select the pause option in the Radar page menu to pause the radar

intent_routes.question: What does the Remote Controller Connection message mean?
question_variations: Why am I seeing Remote Controller Connection?
What's the remote controller status message?
intent_routes.answer: This message indicates that a compatible remote controller is connected to the unit

intent_routes.question: What happens during Data Synchronization?

What's the data sync message mean?
When does data synchronization occur?
intent_routes.answer: Data Synchronization occurs during system startup when the system is synchronizing data

intent_routes.question: What causes a File Transfer Problem?

What does the file transfer problem message mean?
How do I fix file transfer issues?
intent_routes.answer: A File Transfer Problem occurs when there is an interruption in the internet communication

What files are being uploaded?
When does file uploading occur?
intent_routes.answer: The File Uploading message appears when the system is uploading files such as service reports, C-MAP genesis, or route files to PredictWind

intent_routes.question: How do I use a mouse with the Zeus 3S system?
question_variations: What are the mouse controls for Zeus 3S?
Can I connect a mouse to Zeus 3S?
How does the mouse work on Zeus 3S?
intent_routes.answer: Connect mouse to a free USB port. Left click to position cursor or select options. Press and hold left button to drag, select text, pan charts, view sonar history, or move slide bars. Use scroll wheel to zoom or scroll through menus. intent_routes.question: What do the alarm icons mean on the status bar?
question_variations: How can I tell what type of alarm is showing?
What are the different alarm colors?
What do status bar alarms indicate?
intent_routes.answer: Alarm icons appear in three colors: yellow (standard), orange (important), or red (critical). To clear the alarm icon, acknowledge it in the Alarms dialog. You may need to adjust alarm settings or fix the underlying issue to prevent immediate reactivation.
references: Status Bar Icon Definitions Section, p.161

intent_routes.question: What does WAAS mean on the GPS signal indicator?
question_variations: How does WAAS GPS work?
What are the GPS signal strength indicators?
What is the Wide Area Augmentation System?
intent_routes.answer: WAAS (Wide Area Augmentation System) is shown on GPS signal strength indicators and can be strong, medium, or weak. It's an enhancement to the GPS system that provides improved location accuracy.
references: Status Bar Icon Definitions Section, p.161

intent_routes.question: How do I know if my radar is transmitting?
question_variations: What does the radar status icon mean?
Is my radar active or paused?
How can I tell if radar is working?
intent_routes.answer: Check the status bar icons. A specific icon indicates 'Radar Transmitting' when active. If radar is paused, a different icon appears. To start/stop transmission, use the transmit or pause option in the Radar page menu.

intent_routes.question: What autopilot modes are available?
question_variations: How many autopilot settings are there?
What does the autopilot icon show?
What are the different autopilot options?
intent_routes.answer: Available autopilot modes include: Auto-Heading hold, Follow up, Navigation, No drift, and Standby. Use the autopilot controller to select between these modes. The current mode appears in the status bar.
references: Status Bar Icon Definitions Section, p.161
